name: Orthogonal Projection on Invariant Subspaces
description: Translates graph connectivity into linear algebra by representing edges as coordinate swap operators. The connected components become equivalence classes of coordinates, and the requirement to connect vertices becomes a requirement that their corresponding standard basis vectors have identical orthogonal projections onto the subspace invariant under the selected swaps. This completely hides the tree/graph structure and forces the model to mathematically deduce that projection equality is equivalent to transitive coordinate equality (i.e. graph connectivity).
